report_name: Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan (LCWIP)
how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used to identify desire lines for cycle traffic for trips to work and school, and to generate heat maps of indicative demand to inform network development.
other_tools_developed: Multi-Criteria Appraisal Tool (MCAT), GIS LCWIP Model, Route Selection Tool (RST), and Walking Route Audit Tool (WRAT)
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP process has informed the development of a borough-wide primary and secondary cycling and walking network, identified specific infrastructure interventions (such as traffic calming, segregated cycle tracks, and school streets), and established a prioritised list of schemes for future funding bids and developer contributions.
pct_usage_quote: The PCT helps identify desire lines for cycle traffic for trips to work and to schools. It can also help inform network development, as its outputs can be configured to be applied to the existing network, giving ‘heat maps’ of indicative demand.
